title: Namaz for fulfillment of needs (2)
introduction:
ANOTHER NAMAZ FOR FULFILLMENT OF NEEDS (2)

In the fourth chapter of this book, I will mention a number of supplicatory prayers for settling the worldly and religious needs.

In al-Balad al-Amin, al-Kaf’ami states: For urgent needs, the following words may be written on a sheet of paper and then thrown in (current) water:

verses.translation: In the Name of Allah; the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.
O Lord: Harm has afflicted me, and You are the most Merciful of the merciful.
In the name of Muhammad and his Household,

verses.arabic: بِحَقِّ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اٰلِهٖ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اٰلِهٖ
وَاكْشِفْ هَمِّىْ وَ فَرِّجْ عَنِّىْ غَمِّىْ
verses.translation: take off my distress and relieve me from my grief,
out of Your mercy, O most Merciful of all those who show mercy.
